In the same way this verse is Voat looking on at reddit with an occasionally circlejerky, superiority-laden slant, TiA exists for reddit to gawk at tumblr. It's out of context and harsh, it's usually the worst of whatever it happens to be calling out, and a situation or post is held up for everyone to look at-- whether they're just snarking at something or completely ripping posters to shreds in the comments, it's not usually a good thing. I was pretty active in commenting on TiA a while back. Any actual hate speech was downvoted, and deleted. Yes, it is a hate group, and it at least meets Wikipedia's definition. Very generally the posters and subscribers are saying 'look at this person, what an idiot' and then all upvoting one another for saying it. It exists purely to exercise hostility against a subset of people on tumblr so that the posters and subscribers can feel better about themselves and validate their opinions, without stimulating any actual discussion.

I still like it though, because the people who get posted on tumblrinaction are mostly just loopy teenagers and twenty-somethings. They'll grow up once they finish puberty and have to live in the real world.

If you give people the means to create a community around some concept or some group of people they dislike, they will do it. It's a hallmark of the reddit model and is why reddit is a cesspit. Voat is probably going to go the same way, eventually.

I love voat, but I think the reddit site model needs to die, or at least change drastically, because it's too easily abused as a means to foster hatred.
